name: NyaIP
notes:
NyaIP is a special autonomous system designated for experiments and operates under BYoIP or BYoAS clients.
This network does not accept abuse reports, DMCA takedown requests, or similar legal issues. If your matter involves official government action, please submit it via the contact email listed at the bottom of this page. All other submissions will be ignored. Please direct all non-government abuse complaints directly to the registered BYOIP/ByoAS client owner.
